posts.title: Nintendo’s approach to reimagining Ocarina of Time
posts.description: The time is almost upon us. The long awaited remake of Ocarina of Time is about to be released. Yes, we have had a remake before, back in 2011 with the 3D version, but this goes much further than that version did which played it relatively safe; but was impressive for moving to a handheld device and adding glasses free 3D. posts.title: A better name for a specific type of videogame remake
posts.description: I recently delivered my annual lecture on nostalgia and hauntology to my Masters students.
